statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) is ordered
The service is for ambulatory evaluation
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
The denial reason is PR-204 (service not covered under member's current benefit plan)
